blocks.title: Petrochemicals
blocks.text: Petrochemicals woh compounds hain jo zyada tar kache tel aur qudrati gas se refining aur tabdeeli ke zariye hasil hote hain.

Petrochemicals packaging, tameerat, kapre (textiles), electronics aur tibb mein rozmarra ki bohat si cheezein banane mein use hote hain. Petrochemicals se bane masnoi kimiyai maddey un ke derivatives hain, aur yeh bohat ahem sanati products hain. Petrochemicals polymerisation, oxidation ya substitution jaise kimiyai amal se apne derivatives mein badalte hain.

blocks.prompt: Petrochemical aur us se hasil shuda kimiyai maddah mein kya farq hai? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Petrochemical seedha kache tel ya qudrati gas se milta hai (maslan ethene); derivative is se mazeed reaction jaise polymerisation se banta hai (maslan poly(ethene)).
